fusions.name: Warning Musk
fusions.desc: Sprays a fine mist of strands in a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 poison damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave its target [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lingering Reek
fusions.desc: Lashes a stinking strand at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 14 poison damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Turned Back
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stand Your Ground
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, a strand lashes the nearest enemy within 7 tiles and deals 12 poison damage. Once every 40 seconds.
